summary: Only a one-line Forest Lookouts listing (Le Flore County, Ouachita National Forest) was found; no tower history, status or access source located.

evidence.supports: Polecat Peak listed in Le Flore County, Ouachita National Forest
evidence.quote: Le Flore County - Ouachita National Forest

notes_for_editor: No story written. The only source is the Forest Lookouts listing, which gives name, county and forest, and nothing else (the page body ends with a stray letter). Two web searches returned nothing about a tower on Polecat Peak, and the NHLR Oklahoma list (5 registered lookouts) has no Polecat entry. TopoQuest was not checked for this name. A story needs at least 120 words of sourced fact, so it should wait for a Ouachita National Forest or Oklahoma Forestry record, or a visit report, that describes the tower.
